name: Rizzmaxxing

lead: Rizzmaxxing is looksmaxxing-style self-improvement aimed at "rizz", internet slang for charm and the ability to attract people. It treats charisma, conversation, confidence and style as improvable traits alongside physical appearance.
The payoff is a more attractive overall impression: how a person talks, carries themselves and engages often shapes how appealing they look in person.

paras: People practise conversation, humour, eye contact, confident body language and grooming, and often pair this with fitness and style work.
No physical risk; people sometimes describe feeling pressure to perform socially.

angle.text: People work on conversation, confidence and presence so they come across as more attractive. The change is in overall impression, alongside grooming and fitness.

lead: Rizzmaxxing combines "rizz" with the "-maxxing" suffix of looksmaxxing and refers to optimising charisma. Wikipedia reports that rizz likely derives from a clipped form of "charisma" and means charm, style or attractiveness [1].
Streamer Kai Cenat popularised the word in mid-2021, and Oxford University Press named it Word of the Year for 2023 [1].
Practitioners treat charm as a skill that adds to the impression made by looks, voice and style.

paras: Rizz was already used in Cenat's friend group before he popularised it in 2021; it spread on TikTok, mainly among Gen Z [1]. In June 2023, Tom Holland said he had "limited rizz" in a BuzzFeed interview, fuelling memes [1].
Rizzmaxxing is discussed in general terms as improving conversation, humour, confidence and style.

timeline.event: Oxford names rizz Word of the Year [1]
